# 4 Ezra Chapter 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1** The LORD says: I pulled this people out of slavery and handed them my commandments through my servants the prophets — but they refused to listen. They threw my counsel away.

**2** Now their own mother speaks to them: Go, my children. I am a widow, abandoned. I raised you with such joy, and now I watch you leave in grief and sorrow.

**3** You sinned against the LORD your God. You chose evil in my sight.

**4** What can I do for you now? I am widowed and alone. Go, my children — go and beg the LORD for mercy.

**5** But I am calling on you, Father, to witness against the mother of these children, because they refused to honor my covenant.

**6** Strike them with confusion. Reduce their mother to rubble. Let them leave no descendants.

**7** Scatter them among the nations. Erase their names from the earth. They threw away my covenant.

**8** Woe to you, Assyria, harboring the wicked! You evil nation — do you remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrah?

**9** Their land is tar and ash to this day. That is exactly what awaits those who will not hear me. The LORD Almighty has spoken.

**10** And now the LORD says to Ezra: Tell my people — I am giving them the kingdom of Jerusalem, the very one I had planned to give to Israel.

**11** I am reclaiming the glory I gave Israel and transferring it to these people. The eternal homes I built for Israel — they are getting those instead.

**12** The tree of life will be their perfume; they will never have to labor or struggle.

**13** Ask, and you will receive. Pray for the days to be shortened — the kingdom is already ready and waiting for you. Look up!

**14** Let heaven and earth witness: I erased evil and created goodness. The LORD Almighty declares it.

**15** Let the mother hold her children tight. Raise them with joy, like a dove. Keep their feet firm — I have chosen you. The LORD Almighty says so.

**16** Those who have died I will raise from their graves and bring them out from their tombs, because I know my name lives in them.

**17** Do not be afraid, mother of children. I have chosen you. The LORD Almighty promises it.

**18** To help you, I am sending my servants Isaiah and Jeremiah. Through their guidance I have prepared for you twelve trees loaded with every kind of fruit,

**19** springs flowing with milk and honey in abundance, and seven towering mountains blanketed with roses and lilies — and through all of it I will fill your children with joy.

**20** Stand up for widows. Speak up for orphans. Share with the poor. Protect the fatherless. Clothe the naked.

**21** Heal the broken and the helpless. Stop mocking the lame. Take care of the disabled. Let the blind see the light of my glory.

**22** Guard both the elderly and the young within your gates.

**23** Whenever you find the dead, mark their graves and bury them — and I will give you a place of honor in the resurrection.

**24** Rest easy, my people. Your time of rest is coming.

**25** Good nurse — feed your children well. Keep them strong.

**26** Not one of the servants I have entrusted to you will be lost; I will account for every one of them.

**27** Do not worry. When the day of calamity and terror comes, others will weep and wail — but you will celebrate and have more than enough.

**28** Every nation will look on you with envy, but none of them will be able to touch you. The LORD Almighty says so.

**29** My own hands will shield you so your children never have to face the pit.

**30** Be glad, mother, along with your children — I am going to rescue you. The LORD Almighty declares it.

**31** Do not forget your children who are sleeping in death. I will bring them out of their hiding places in the earth and show them mercy, because I am a God of mercy. The LORD Almighty says so.

**32** Hold your children close until I come to announce mercy to them. My springs never run dry, and my grace will never give out.

**33** I, Ezra, received orders from the LORD at Mount Horeb to go to Israel. When I got there, they rejected me and threw the LORD's command back in my face.

**34** So I am telling you now — you people who are willing to listen and understand: Wait for your shepherd. He will give you a rest that never ends. The one who is coming at the close of the age is almost here.

**35** Get ready for your kingdom reward. The eternal light is going to shine on you forever.

**36** Walk away from this age's shadow. Take hold of the joy that is yours in glory. I call on my Savior as my witness right now.

**37** Take what has been entrusted to you, be glad, and thank the one who invited you into the heavenly kingdoms.

**38** Stand up and look: see how many are sealed at the LORD's feast —

**39** those who turned their backs on this world's shadow and received magnificent robes from the LORD.

**40** Count your full number, Zion. Close the register of those dressed in white who kept the LORD's law.

**41** The number of your children is complete — the full count you longed for. Petition the LORD's power to make holy your people, called from the very beginning.

**42** I, Ezra, had a vision on Mount Zion. I saw a crowd so vast I could not begin to count them, and every one of them was praising the LORD in song.

**43** At the center of them stood a young man of extraordinary height — taller than anyone else there. He was placing crowns on each person's head, and the taller he grew the more awestruck I became.

**44** I turned to an angel: Who are all these people, my lord?

**45** The angel answered: These are the ones who shed the garment of death and put on immortality. They declared God's name openly. Now they receive their crowns and their palms.

**46** I asked again: And who is that remarkable young man setting the crowns and handing out the palms?

**47** The angel said: He is the Son of God — the one they proclaimed while they were still in the world. And I broke out in praise for all those who had held their ground so bravely for the LORD's name.

**48** Then the angel said to me: Now go — tell my people what you have seen, and how vast and magnificent are the wonders of the LORD God.
